//TR: Bu checkpoint Founder yetkili F10 (.gitattributes LF sabitleme) ve F9 (Electron smoke shell'siz başlatma) düzeltmelerini, doğrulama/adversarial kanıtlarını ve Electron binary temini için açık Founder kararını kaydeder; CLEAN, final closure veya target-machine Phase0 PASS iddiası değildir.

founderAuthorization.F10: Add protected .gitattributes that stores and checks out every text file with LF so Windows core.autocrlf=true clones keep lock, trust-root and evidence digests equal to committed bytes.
founderAuthorization.F9: Launch Electron in smoke-desktop.mjs and smoke-control-tower.mjs without electron.cmd and without a shell; verify Electron 44 binary provisioning under ignore-scripts and report it as a separate decision if needed.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

implementation.F10: .gitattributes contains '* text=auto eol=lf'; the index was already LF for all 1935 tracked files, so no content renormalization occurred.
implementation.F9: Both smokes resolve the Electron binary inline (no new protected helper): path.txt must be one of electron.exe, electron or Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron, dist/version must equal the installed electron package version, and the binary must be a regular file; the binary is spawned directly without shell. Missing or mismatched provisioning fails closed with ELECTRON_BINARY_NOT_PROVISIONED.
implementation.F9DeviationFromLiteralAuthorization: The authorization text named 'node + electron cli'. Verification showed electron@44.4.5 cli.js/index.js silently downloads the binary from GitHub on first require and extracts it into node_modules/electron/dist, which also breaks the installed-tree seal. The smokes therefore launch the verified binary directly and never trigger that download; this is stricter than the literal text and stays inside the two authorized files.
implementation.previousBehaviour: Both smokes spawned node_modules\.bin\electron.cmd with shell:true on Windows, which implicitly downloaded the binary through electron/index.js.

validation.workspace: fresh clone of v6/pkg-c-lf-and-electron-smoke mirroring the working tree with the reviewed lock installed; repository .ai/runtime untouched
validation.vitest: PASS 16 files / 81 tests (9 new PKG-C tests)

openFindings.observed: No reviewed provisioning step exists for the electron@44.4.5 binary under ignore-scripts; the upstream lazy download writes into node_modules/electron/dist and invalidates the installed-tree seal. scripts/install.ps1 control-tower-smoke now fails closed until provisioning is decided (-SkipDesktopSmoke remains available).
